title: A Home Assistant dashboard with Decluttering Card Plus templates

decluttering_templates.description: Templates by name. Each is a card, row, badge, element or group with [[placeholders]] for what changes.

decluttering_defaults.description: Values every template on this dashboard falls back to, as a list of single-key mappings or one mapping.

decluttering_variables.description: Variable declarations shared by every template; a template takes one up by naming it.

decluttering_let.description: Values worked out once for the whole dashboard, read by every template.

decluttering_templates_from.description: Dashboards to borrow templates from, by url path; "*" for all of them.

views.description: The views. A view, section or card inside is not checked by this schema beyond its decluttering cards.
